note: General preference order is a fallback. Per-model `priority` (best-first) is authoritative; `fit_ladders` applies class awareness (apple/darwin, GPU, unified) on top of it. `probe_order` is the TurboFit Check registry order; per-engine runtime fields (display_name, openai_port, install_hint, detect, endpoint_discoverable) make engine registration a data-only edit.

llama.cpp.install_hint: Install Turbofit's pinned native llama.cpp runtime.
llama.cpp.maple_gguf: stamsam/llama.cpp prism fork only; mainline cannot load maple or TQ2_0 type 35

mlx.serves: MLX weights via mlx-lm or mlx-lm-deepgrove
mlx.install_hint: Install mlx-lm on Apple Silicon macOS.

sglang.serves: HuggingFace / FP8 / some standard GGUF via sglang.launch_server
sglang.install_hint: Install SGLang on native Linux or inside WSL.
sglang.maple_gguf: incompatible; maple arch is not in SGLang
sglang.qwen38_gguf: prefer Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B HF; standard Qwen GGUF is optional and unproven here

vllm.serves: HuggingFace / FP8 / NVFP4 via vllm serve
vllm.install_hint: Install vLLM on Linux/WSL or vLLM-Metal on Apple Silicon.
vllm.maple_gguf: incompatible; maple arch is not in vLLM
vllm.qwen38_gguf: prefer Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B or NVFP4/FP8 recipes, not GSQ-RCO GGUF

freetoken.serves: HF safetensors or FTW MoE via ft on Linux x86_64 CUDA 13 / driver r580+
freetoken.install_hint: Install freetoken[accel] on Linux x86_64 with CUDA 13.
freetoken.maple_gguf: incompatible; FreeToken does not load maple GGUF
freetoken.qwen38_gguf: incompatible as GGUF; only if a supported HF MoE recipe exists
freetoken.cyber_tiel_gguf: candidate only after an exact FreeToken recipe

turbohaul-manager.serves: OpenAI/Ollama-compatible manager over a llama.cpp backend
turbohaul-manager.install_hint: Install MrTrenchTrucker/turbohaul-manager from its pinned GitHub release.
turbohaul-manager.maple_gguf: only if the managed llama.cpp binary is the Maple fork
turbohaul-manager.qwen38_gguf: preferred manager over pinned mainline llama.cpp
turbohaul-manager.cyber_tiel_gguf: preferred manager over pinned mainline llama.cpp

strata.serves: Qwen3.8 Flash Next (125B MoE) via expert tiering: hot experts on GPU, all in RAM, n-gram on SSD
strata.install_hint: Install Strata with scripts/install-strata-runtime (Qwen3.8 Flash Next 125B MoE).
strata.qwen38_gguf: incompatible; Strata serves Flash Next, not Qwen 3.8 27B
strata.flash_next: IQ2_XS recommended; 12-24 GB VRAM + 64 GB RAM; 60-95 tok/s on RTX 5070

prism-llama.cpp.serves: Ternary Bonsai 2 27B / Underdog 27B via PrismML llama.cpp fork (CUDA, Metal, CPU)
prism-llama.cpp.install_hint: Install PrismML-Eng/llama.cpp fork for Ternary Bonsai 2 (CUDA, Metal, CPU).
prism-llama.cpp.qwen38_gguf: incompatible; Prism fork serves Ternary Bonsai 2 / Underdog, not Qwen 3.8 27B
prism-llama.cpp.bonsai2_gguf: PTQ1_0 (5.95 GB) or PQ2_0 (7.21 GB); 262K context; ~47 tok/s on M5 Max

salt-core.serves: Dense 27B via KV-cache offload to host RAM + expert/weight disk streaming from HDD + n-gram 262K context
salt-core.install_hint: Candidate engine (qualification gate pending): 4 GB VRAM / 16 GB RAM / HDD box; derived from Strata n-gram + llama.cpp --split-mode row + mmap.
salt-core.note: Qualification gate: 4 GB VRAM / 16 GB RAM / HDD box. Pass = 4-8 tok/s sustained, 262K context, <2% hallucination delta vs 24 GB, single-process launch. Target 8-12 tok/s once KV offload is tuned.
salt-core.source: derived: Strata n-gram + llama.cpp --split-mode row + mmap

upstream.paper: SALT: Reusable Computation for Stateful Language-Model Inference (https://zenodo.org/records/23111764)

saliency.serves: Dense 27B via dynamic token pruning + KV offload + disk streaming (candidate)
saliency.install_hint: Candidate engine (qualification gate pending): requires a qualified 27B pruning checkpoint + custom pruning kernels.
saliency.note: Target 40-80 tok/s on 4 GB VRAM. Requires a verified 27B pruning checkpoint + custom pruning kernels (SGLang-style). Not runnable until a checkpoint is qualified.

qwen3-8-flash-next-strata.darwin_status: candidate; no released macOS engine for Flash Next yet
